description: This file defines a Java interface for repository operations related to the 'Answer' entity, extending Spring Data JPA's JpaRepository to provide CRUD functionality and a custom method to find answers by question ID.

classes.name: AnswerRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for Answer entities extending JpaRepository, including method for finding answers by question ID.

methods.name: findByQuestionId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Answer objects associated with a specific question ID.
